agent_assessment: SnoozePopover has been correctly refactored to use the portal-based Popover component, matching the StatusChipPopover pattern exactly. The component now uses createPortal to render at document.body with fixed positioning and viewport clamping, escaping the overflow-x-auto constraint on backlog-card.tsx:111. The external API (itemKey, onSnooze, children) is unchanged, so all 4 usage sites (3 in backlog-card.tsx, 1 in ExecutionCaptureCard.tsx) require no modifications. Click-outside and Escape dismissal are handled by useModalBehavior via the Popover component. Position is computed from getBoundingClientRect on click, consistent with the plan.
notes: Implementation follows the plan precisely — uses Popover component with buttonRef, popoverPos state, and getBoundingClientRect positioning
The wrapper changed from <div className="relative"> to a React fragment (<>), which is correct since portal rendering eliminates the need for a relative positioning context
useCallback is still imported for handleOpen — this is fine and arguably better than an inline arrow since the handler does non-trivial work (getBoundingClientRect + state update)
No runtime verification was possible (swarm-manager UI not running in this context) — visual testing should confirm the popover is no longer clipped by the action row's overflow-x-auto

evidence.title: SnoozePopover uses portal-based Popover component
evidence.description: SnoozePopover.tsx imports and renders <Popover> from ../ui/popover (line 11, 46-53). The Popover component uses createPortal(…, document.body) at popover.tsx:75-90, which renders the dropdown at the document root — completely escaping the overflow-x-auto boundary on the backlog card action row (backlog-card.tsx:111).

evidence.title: Fixed positioning with viewport clamping
evidence.description: SnoozePopover computes position via getBoundingClientRect (line 26-28) and passes x/y to Popover. The Popover component applies fixed positioning (popover.tsx:79,84) and clamps to viewport edges (popover.tsx:55-71), preventing edge-of-screen clipping.

evidence.title: Click-outside and Escape dismissal via useModalBehavior
evidence.description: The Popover component calls useModalBehavior({ isOpen, onClose, ref: menuRef }) at popover.tsx:47-52, which handles click-outside detection and Escape key dismissal. SnoozePopover no longer needs manual handleClickOutside logic — the old useEffect and useCallback for click-outside have been removed.

evidence.title: External API unchanged — no usage site modifications needed
evidence.description: SnoozePopover still accepts { itemKey, onSnooze, children } (line 13-17). All 4 usage sites confirmed unchanged: backlog-card.tsx lines 351, 391, 401 and ExecutionCaptureCard.tsx line 70. The wrapper element changed from <div className='relative'> to a fragment, but this doesn't affect card layout since the trigger button flows inline.

evidence.title: Snooze preset functionality preserved
evidence.description: SNOOZE_PRESETS.map renders preset buttons (lines 55-69) with onClick handlers that call onSnooze(itemKey, getPresetExpiry(preset)) and setOpen(false). The snooze logic is identical to the original — only the rendering container changed from absolute-positioned div to portal-based Popover.
